diagram_math_checks.justification: Item Given fixes f:X→Y with f(U)⊆U′ and f(V)⊆V′. Hence restriction maps U∩V→U′∩V′, U→U′ and V→V′ yield downward covariant singular chain maps and homology maps, not pullbacks. Composition carries cover-small chains A_X to A_Y. thm-short-exact-two-open-singular-chain-mayer-vietoris-sequence Statement fixes i(c)=(c,-c), j(u,v)=u+v, with target A_X. Thus (f#⊕f#)i(c)=(f#c,-f#c)=i′f#c, and f_s j(u,v)=f#u+f#v=j′(f#⊕f#)(u,v). The primed row has exactly the same ordered-cover convention. Item step 1.1 supplies these maps and relations.

diagram_math_checks.justification: The first three columns are H_n(U∩V), H_n(U)⊕H_n(V), H_n(X), and primed counterparts. Step 2.1 and thm-cover-small-singular-chains-compute-singular-homology identify H_n(A_X) with H_n(X) compatibly with f. Therefore the first two homology squares follow from the chain squares, using the induced inclusion difference and inclusion sum maps. No reversed maps or degree shifts occur there.

The last arrows have domain H_n(X), respectively H_n(Y), and codomain H_{n−1}(U∩V), respectively H_{n−1}(U′∩V′), for n≥1. def-mayer-vietoris-connecting-class and item step 3.1 give δ_X[z]=[∂u] for z=u+v, because ∂(u,v)=(∂u,−∂u)=i(∂u). Consequently δ_Y f_*[z]=[∂f#u]=f_*[∂u]=f_*δ_X[z]. The same positive U-boundary sign is used in both rows. The connector-independence lemma supplies representative independence.

The drawn homology segment is explicitly restricted to n≥1. The text treats degree zero via H_0(X)→0 and H_0(Y)→0, without introducing reduced or negative-degree homology. Singular chains and ordinary homology of an empty cover member or overlap are zero; the maps and commutativity equations remain valid, as for G=0. The entire original claim/proof and frontmatter remain byte-identical as a prefix; the figures only summarize its relations.
